reviews.text:
Bad diagnosis, risked My pet's health.

My experience here was truly disheartening 😔.
The diagnosis provided for my beloved pet was completely off, and it seriously jeopardized their well-being 💔.
I wouldn't recommend this place; the care was substandard and caused unnecessary worry 😟.
My pet's health was at risk due to their poor judgment 😠.

Dr. Lincoln provided terrible service. He shouldn't be a veterinarian. We took our dog to him for a problem with one eye, and he said it was trauma. It healed, but after we stopped giving him medication, he brought him back and said he'd hit it. I went to another veterinarian, and he told me to get an ultrasound. I went to a third appointment with Lincoln because my husband insisted, and he told us the ultrasound wasn't necessary and that he'd tell me anyway that the dog had glaucoma. The next day, I went to another veterinarian, and they did the ultrasound and told me the dog's eye couldn't be saved. I went back to the doctor for a month; during that time, he could have done other tests, but he refused. Honestly, take your dog somewhere else.
Very professional, she saved my dog's eye
Excellent service, everything was very well explained and the price was great 👍 …
Excellent service, friendly and professional, highly recommended
The veterinarian who attended to me was very attentive. I explained that the dog I was with was a rescue, and he was very punctual in providing the veterinary care she required.
Excellent service. I highly recommend it.
Excellent service from all the staff and very nice aesthetics
I went to Dr. Licona for cataract surgery for my pet and the care was excellent. I am very grateful for the process and especially that my pet's vision improved.
I've been taking my dogs here for baths for years and I've always had a good experience :)
Good service, professional and very accurate in ophthalmological diagnoses.
Excellent service. Experts. Attentive. The best!!

If you love your pet, DO NOT go to this veterinary hospital. We took our dog, who had already had surgery, here for a second opinion yesterday. The vet's mistreatment, his pulling and aggressive manner ended up opening the stitches in his eye. Our dog wouldn't let him treat him, and instead of helping him, he blamed us for his behavior. He yelled at us, saying it was our fault the dog wouldn't let him treat him. He's the professional and should have examined him or had one of his assistants help him. This person is a mercenary; he doesn't love dogs the way we love our companions.
Terrible service in emergency cases and their poor diagnoses waste time in resolving the problem, errors they should not make.

If you have the chance to go, don't. He's a completely incompetent doctor who makes you spend more than necessary. Two acquaintances have already taken their dogs there, and both dogs died due to his misdiagnoses and poor care.
They gave my dog ​​sugar water, supposedly to raise her blood sugar, but it ended up killing her.
